title: Noetherian descends along faithfully flat ring maps
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a faithfully flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] with $S$ a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ is a Noetherian ring.
